title: ONI Companion theme (v1.1)
description: Named tokens only; blocks stay layout-free and each front end maps tokens to its own widgets. `Theme` is the GET /api/v1/theme reply. `ModTheme` is companion/theme/<build>/theme.json written by the mod once per build (colors read from the game's own UI style assets, never hand-picked; PNGs rendered from the running game on the user's device, none shipped). With no game theme the core returns the built-in dark theme (source "builtin", no images).

positive.description: Good values and the good tone.

negative.description: Bad values and the bad tone.

warning.description: The warn tone and warn badges. Optional: front ends fall back to a mix of positive and negative.

sectionHeader.description: v1.2, optional. Fill of a section header bar (the game's STATUS / CONDITION bars). Average of the sectionHeader slice's fill area.

sectionHeaderText.description: v1.2, optional. Text on a section header bar.

tabBg.description: v1.2, optional. Fill of an inactive tab (average of the tab slice's fill area).

tabActiveBg.description: v1.2, optional. Fill of the active tab.

tabText.description: v1.2, optional. Label of an inactive tab; always readable on tabBg.

tabTextActive.description: v1.2, optional. Label of the active tab; always readable on tabActiveBg.

alertBg.description: v1.2, optional, may be translucent (#RRGGBBAA). Background of the game's alert list rows.

alertText.description: v1.2, optional. Text of an alert row.

alertBadBg.description: v1.2, optional. Background of a bad (red) alert row.

alertBadText.description: v1.2, optional. Text of a bad alert row.

FontRole.description: v1.2. A font role. The theme names a role, never a file: the front end maps the role to a font it loaded from GET /fonts, else to `fallback`.

family.description: The game's family name for the role (Noto Sans, Graystroke, Economica, League Spartan).

font.description: Name of the GET /fonts entry that provides it. Absent while that font is not synced yet.

fallback.description: Families to use in order when the font is missing, e.g. ["Economica", "Noto Sans"].

header.description: Section and page headers (the game: Graystroke, an SDF atlas; front ends may draw it with the atlas or fall back).

family.description: A font the front end already has (Noto Sans); the fallback for every role.

roles.description: v1.2, optional. The core fills it from the fonts it extracted/received; absent on the builtin theme and before the first sync.

IconName.description: v1.2. Icon names the mod's theme export may supply: speedPause, speedPlay, speed1, speed2, speed3 (the game's speed control), and alertBad, alertMinorBad, alertNeutral, alertGood, alertEvent, alertTutorial, alertThreatening, alertMessage, alertMessageImportant (alertNeutral, alertMinorBad and alertGood may point at the same file). A front end draws a plain icon for any name it lacks.

Icon.description: v1.2. GET /theme form: a single image, `art` is /api/v1/art/ui/<name>. `activeArt` is the pressed/selected look when the game has one.

ModIcon.description: v1.2. Mod file form of an Icon.

ModSlice.description: Mod file form: `file` is relative to the theme folder (companion/theme/<build>/).

build.description: Game build the game theme was read from.

slices.description: Empty for the builtin theme: front ends draw plain rectangles.

icons.description: v1.2, optional. Speed-control and alert icons from the game. Absent: plain icons.

renderRev.description: v1.2, optional. Version of the theme the mod renders; the mod rebuilds the theme only when the game build or this number changes.

icons.description: v1.2, optional. Files are in the same theme folder.
